Deposit.faqQ1: What should I do to ensure a successful deposit?
Deposit.faqA1: Always double-check the deposit address and network type before sending funds. Ensure you are depositing the correct asset (e.g., USDT) to the specified address and using the supported network.
Deposit.faqQ2: What happens if I send funds to the wrong address?
Deposit.faqA2: Transactions on the blockchain are irreversible. If you send to the wrong address or network, Limiance cannot recover your funds. Always verify the address before confirming.
Deposit.faqQ3: Can I deposit using a smart contract?
Deposit.faqA3: Some assets do not support deposits via smart contracts. If a smart contract is used, the deposited funds will not be credited and will not be refunded. Check asset-specific notes for details.
Deposit.faqQ4: How long does it take for my deposit to be credited?
Deposit.faqA4: Most deposits are credited after receiving the required number of blockchain confirmations, typically within a few minutes. High network congestion may cause minor delays.
Deposit.creditTooltip: Assets will be credited once the required confirmations are reached.
Deposit.fundsAvailable: Funds are available to trade or transfer right away.
Deposit.fiatDepositSubtitle: Fund your account with NGN via bank transfer or card
Deposit.fiatDepositNote: Fiat deposits are NGN-only and settled via Monnify. Prefer trading with merchants instead?
Deposit.fiatFaqQ1: How long does a bank transfer deposit take to be credited?
Deposit.fiatFaqA1: Once you transfer to your one-time virtual account and confirm the deposit, Monnify verifies that the transfer actually settled before we credit your account. This is usually instant, but can take a few minutes during bank downtime.
Deposit.fiatFaqQ2: Can I use the same virtual account number twice?
Deposit.fiatFaqA2: No. Every deposit request creates a fresh one-time NGN virtual account that expires automatically after the displayed duration. Always transfer to the account number shown on screen.
Deposit.fiatFaqQ3: What happens if I transfer more or less than the requested amount?
Deposit.fiatFaqA3: Transfers that do not match the expected settlement amount may not be auto-credited. Transfer exactly the total payable amount shown to ensure a smooth deposit.
Deposit.fiatFaqQ4: Why do I need to confirm my deposit?
Deposit.fiatFaqA4: The confirm step asks Monnify whether your bank transfer actually settled before we credit your crypto. You should only tap confirm after your bank shows the transfer as successful.
Deposit.fiatFaqQ5: Is there a minimum or maximum deposit?
Deposit.fiatFaqA5: Minimum and maximum limits follow your account’s deposit rules. The buy page and the quote endpoint enforce the exact window for your account tier.

Withdrawal.warningText: Please confirm you are withdrawing {asset} to an address on the {network} network. Using an incorrect address or unsupported network may result in the permanent loss of your assets.
Withdrawal.faqQ1: How long does a withdrawal take?
Withdrawal.faqA1: Withdrawals are typically processed within 1–5 minutes, depending on network congestion and verification requirements.
Withdrawal.faqQ2: What are the fees for withdrawing assets?
Withdrawal.faqA2: Network fees vary by asset and chain. The exact fee is displayed before you confirm the withdrawal. Fees are deducted from the withdrawn amount.
Withdrawal.faqQ3: Why is my withdrawal request under review or delayed?
Withdrawal.faqA3: Large or unusual withdrawals may trigger additional security checks. This is to protect your account. Please allow up to 24 hours for review.
Withdrawal.faqA4: Withdrawals that are already submitted to the blockchain cannot be cancelled. If your withdrawal is still in ‘Pending’ status due to review, please contact support.
Withdrawal.faqQ5: What if my withdrawal isn’t credited?
Withdrawal.faqA5: Ensure you provided the correct address and network. If the transaction hash is confirmed on the blockchain but not credited by the recipient, please contact the relevant platform’s support.

Withdrawal.requiresKycNote: Requires KYC Tier 1 and an enabled withdrawal account. Rate-limited to 5 withdrawals per minute.
Withdrawal.fiatFaqQ1: How long does a fiat withdrawal take?
Withdrawal.fiatFaqA1: Fiat payouts are processed through Monnify and typically reach your bank within minutes, though some banks may take up to 24 hours to reflect the credit.
Withdrawal.fiatFaqQ2: Why do I need to authorize some withdrawals?
Withdrawal.fiatFaqA2: When 2FA disbursement is enabled, Monnify sends a confirmation code to your registered phone. Enter that code to authorize the payout before it is released.
Withdrawal.fiatFaqQ3: What are the limits on fiat withdrawals?
Withdrawal.fiatFaqA3: Withdrawals require KYC Tier 1, an enabled withdrawal account, and are rate-limited to 5 per minute per user. Your account balance caps the maximum amount.
Withdrawal.fiatFaqA4: Payouts go to Nigerian banks in NGN. Your crypto is converted to NGN at the settlement rate before the bank transfer is initiated.
